For your stay in Chiang Mai, I recommend basing yourself around **Prapokklao Road in the Old City**. This area has a vibrant atmosphere with plenty of attractions, cafes, and street food. Other great areas include **Nantaram Rd** and **Chaiyapoom Rd**, which also have some excellent hostels.
